name: Will my insurance cover storm cleanup services?

mainEntity.name: Will my insurance cover storm cleanup services?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most standard homeowner's insurance policies cover damage caused by sudden and accidental events, which typically includes storm damage. However, coverage can vary depending on your specific policy and the cause of the damage (e.g., flood insurance is separate). We can work directly with your insurance company, helping to document the damage and streamline the claims process for covered services.
